description: This file defines the JobCategoryService class, which provides business logic for managing job categories in the OrangeHRM system. It interacts with the JobCategoryDao for database operations, includes dependency injection, and offers methods for CRUD operations and normalization.

classes.name: JobCategoryService
classes.description: A service class that manages job category data, providing methods to retrieve, save, delete, and normalize job categories by leveraging the DAO and normalization traits.

methods.name: setJobCategoryDao
methods.description: Sets the JobCategoryDao instance for dependency injection.

methods.name: getJobCategoryList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of job categories, optionally sorted and paginated, or just counts.

methods.name: getJobCategoryById
methods.description: Fetches a specific JobCategory entity by its ID.

methods.name: saveJobCategory
methods.description: Persists a JobCategory entity into the database.

methods.name: deleteJobCategory
methods.description: Deletes multiple job categories by their IDs and returns the count of deleted records.

methods.name: getJobCategoryArray
methods.description: Returns an array of normalized job category data helpful for API responses or UI rendering.
